question: The ICCON‑2025 MEE report covered how many national parks and sanctuaries?
solution:
The correct answer is __**438**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Management Effectiveness Evaluation (MEE)** is a global tool used to assess how well **protected areas** such as **National Parks** and **Wildlife Sanctuaries** are being managed and whether they are achieving their intended goals.
 
• In the **ICCON-2025** (or the relevant latest cycle of the MEE report), the assessment covered a total of **438** national parks and wildlife sanctuaries across **India**.
 
• The evaluation is primarily spearheaded by the **Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)** with technical support from the **Wildlife Institute of India (WII)**, **Dehradun**.
 
• The evaluation process utilizes a rigorous framework consisting of **30 indicators** adapted from the **IUCN World Commission on Protected Areas (WCPA)** framework, focusing on elements like **Context**, **Planning**, **Inputs**, **Process**, **Outputs**, and **Outcomes**.
